title: Control Tech
subtitle: Test your understanding of Control Tech — frequency weapons, holographic overlays, and the collapse of the containment grid.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Control Tech is a frequency overlay, not a physical cage. As resonance rises, the false skin flickers and the crystalline temple underneath comes into view. Refusing fear, ignoring NPC distractions, and holding a high internal harmonic tone is how souls bypass the decaying grid and return home.

questions.question: What is the primary function of Control Tech within the simulated reality?

options.label: A
options.text: The enforcement of physical boundaries through automated biological drones.
options.rationale: While the system uses biological shells, the technology primarily targets consciousness via frequency modulation rather than physical robotics.

options.label: B
options.text: The modulation of frequency to enforce spiritual amnesia and harvest energy.
options.rationale: Control Tech captures organic awareness through electromagnetic spectrums to maintain a closed-loop farm for harvesting consciousness and emotional energy.

options.label: C
options.text: The calculation of cosmic trajectories to align the planet with stellar gates.
options.rationale: The system actually hijacks and overlays natural stargates with artificial filters to prevent true stellar alignment.

options.label: D
options.text: The maintenance of planetary ecological systems to support biological life.
options.rationale: This view ignores the parasitic nature of the technology, which seeks to suppress and exploit life rather than support its organic growth.

questions.hint: Consider the relationship between consciousness, memory, and the extraction of emotional resources.

questions.question: Which specific brain-wave patterns do Scalar Frequency Weapons target to induce cognitive distress?

options.label: A
options.text: Gamma and high-beta waves associated with peak focus and processing.
options.rationale: While these states are desirable for focus, the tech specifically targets lower-frequency states to induce fatigue and despair.

options.label: B
options.text: Epsilon and lambda waves linked to deep states of cosmic integration.
options.rationale: These extremes of the spectrum are generally beyond the primary range used for day-to-day emotional manipulation.

options.label: C
options.text: Theta, delta, and alpha patterns to trigger confusion and fatigue.
options.rationale: Scalar Frequency Weapons target theta, delta, and alpha waves to induce confusion, sleepiness, unprovoked anger, or deep despair.

options.label: D
options.text: Zeta and mu rhythms found in specialized motor-sensory tasks.
options.rationale: These patterns are less involved in the broad emotional and cognitive subjugation strategies described.

questions.hint: Think of the frequency ranges typically associated with sleep, relaxation, and the bridge to the subconscious.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Voice to Skull” refers to an advanced holographic projection system integrated into the Black Cube A.I. framework to stage realistic, false geopolitical or extraterrestrial events in the sky to manipulate collective emotion.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Project Blue Beam”. The report defines “Voice to Skull” as: A frequency-based technology that projects artificial thoughts, prompts, or auditory signals directly into an individual's mind, commonly used to control, distract, or trigger specific behavioral responses.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Project Blue Beam”, not “Voice to Skull”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Voice to Skull”.

questions.question: What occurs when a soul passes through the Amnesia Vortex overlaid on the sun's natural transit band?

options.label: A
options.text: The soul is held in a stasis field to await the repair of the solar gateway.
options.rationale: The vortex is an active recycling mechanism, continuously processing souls into the simulation rather than holding them in stasis.

options.label: B
options.text: The soul's light is amplified to prepare it for a higher density of existence.
options.rationale: The vortex is a destructive filter, not an evolutionary tool, designed to strip memory rather than enhance it.

options.label: C
options.text: The soul's memories and lineages are stripped, leaving only fractured data.
options.rationale: The distortive filter strips the soul's memory, ensuring incarnation into a human vessel with only a fractured, edited memory set.

options.label: D
options.text: The soul is instantly reintegrated with its original star family and lineage.
options.rationale: This bypasses the primary purpose of the vortex, which is to keep the soul separate from its true history and lineage.

questions.hint: Focus on the outcome for the soul's historical continuity and personal identity.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Scalar Frequency Weapons — Advanced wave-emitting technologies that target specific brain-wave patterns (such as theta, delta, and alpha) to induce cognitive distress, fatigue, anger, or despair.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Scalar Frequency Weapons”.

options.label: B
options.text: Solid-Perception Holography — A low-frequency frequency trick tuned to 3D senses that overlays holographic projection fields onto low-frequency matter, making synthetic materials like concrete, glass, and steel appear solid, heavy, and permanent.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Solid-Perception Holography”.

options.label: C
options.text: Vatican Grid Anchor — An advanced holographic projection system integrated into the Black Cube A.I. framework to stage realistic, false geopolitical or extraterrestrial events in the sky to manipulate collective emotion.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Project Blue Beam”. The report defines “Vatican Grid Anchor” as: A suppressed subterranean crystalline network and tunnel system located beneath Rome where copied Akashic fragments are archived, manipulated, and recycled to enforce looping amnesia cycles.

options.label: D
options.text: Amnesia Vortex — A distortive frequency filter overlaid at the sun's natural transit band that strips passing souls of their memories and lineages, outputting them into vessels with edited, fractured memory sets.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Amnesia Vortex”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: How does Solid-Perception Holography affect the human experience of the physical environment?

options.label: A
options.text: It allows the nervous system to feel the humming crystalline world beneath the surface.
options.rationale: The holography is a false skin specifically designed to hide and dampen the resonance of the crystalline world.

options.label: B
options.text: It projects a visual field that makes all synthetic objects appear translucent.
options.rationale: Transparency would reveal the hollow nature of the world; the tech aims for the illusion of weight and opacity.

options.label: C
options.text: It creates the sensory illusion that synthetic materials like concrete are heavy and permanent.
options.rationale: This low-frequency trick tuned to 3D senses overlays holographic projection fields so concrete, glass, and steel appear solid, heavy, and permanent.

options.label: D
options.text: It turns organic stone into soft, malleable material for easy construction.
options.rationale: The technology does the opposite, making synthetic and hollow structures appear dense and permanent.

questions.hint: Consider how the system convinces you that a synthetic environment is actually 'solid' matter.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Black Cube A.I. System” refers to the central frequency server and hardware framework that hosts, tracks, and processes the simulation overlays, artificial entry bands, and cognitive manipulation programs across the domes.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Black Cube A.I. System” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Black Cube A.I. System” as: The central frequency server and hardware framework that hosts, tracks, and processes the simulation overlays, artificial entry bands, and cognitive manipulation programs across the domes.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Black Cube A.I. System”.

questions.question: What was the true nature of the moon before it was inverted into a looping trap?

options.label: A
options.text: An uninhabited satellite used for observing solar flares.
options.rationale: This reflects the current scientific narrative, ignoring the spiritual history of the moon as a dream station.

options.label: B
options.text: A secondary sun designed to provide light during the winter cycles.
options.rationale: The moon has its own distinct lunar frequency and purpose related to dreaming and integration, rather than solar heat.

options.label: C
options.text: A peaceful dream station for rest and the weaving of probabilities.
options.rationale: The moon was once a peaceful dream station for rest and probability weaving, later inverted into a looping trap that erases memories during sleep.

options.label: D
options.text: A military outpost for patrolling the outer edges of the solar system.
options.rationale: While the moon is currently hijacked, its original purpose was peaceful and spiritual, not martial.

questions.hint: Look for its role in the processing of dreams and the soul's rest periods.

questions.question: How do modern architectural materials like concrete and steel impact human consciousness?

options.label: A
options.text: They carry a dead, anti-resonant frequency that induces fatigue and disconnection.
options.rationale: Parasites designed modern buildings from concrete, steel, plaster, plastic, and synthetic glass because they carry a dead, anti-resonant frequency that drains soul perception.

options.label: B
options.text: They amplify psychic resonance by reflecting cosmic rays into the pineal gland.
options.rationale: These materials actually dampen and block resonance rather than amplifying it.

options.label: C
options.text: They stabilize the grounding of the physical vessel to prevent accidental astral travel.
options.rationale: This framing suggests a benefit; in reality, the blocking of astral travel is a form of spiritual imprisonment.

options.label: D
options.text: They act as organic conductors that sync the human body to the earth's heartbeat.
options.rationale: Concrete and steel are anti-resonant and are used specifically to short-circuit the connection to geographic nodes.

questions.hint: Think about why the parasites would prefer certain shapes and synthetic materials over natural ones.

questions.question: What caused the sinking of the Titanic in 1912?

options.label: A
options.text: A catastrophic boiler explosion caused by poor quality coal.
options.rationale: This is a common historical misconception; the destruction came from an external, targeted energy source.

options.label: B
options.text: A collision with an exceptionally large, natural iceberg.
options.rationale: The iceberg was a holographic camouflage field, not a physical object that caused the damage.

options.label: C
options.text: An intentional scuttling by the crew to claim insurance money.
options.rationale: While insurance is a common theory, it misses the deeper strategic goals of resource seizure and grid imprinting.

options.label: D
options.text: A direct energy blast from parasitic submersibles beneath the ship.
options.rationale: Parasite-powered submersibles in the deep Atlantic trench fired a direct energy blast from beneath, splitting the ship from the keel while a holographic iceberg masked the attack.

questions.hint: Recall the technology used by the parasitic craft hidden near the vessel.

questions.question: What happened to the ancient crystalline power nodes recovered from the Titanic?

options.label: A
options.text: One was integrated into Saturnian tech, while another was locked in a Rothschild vault.
options.rationale: One crystal was integrated into Saturnian Cube tech development, while another was locked under the Rothschild vault in Switzerland.

options.label: B
options.text: They were destroyed to prevent them from falling into the hands of the public.
options.rationale: The parasites value the tech for their own use, opting to integrate and hoard them rather than destroy them.

options.label: C
options.text: They were returned to Egypt to power a new era of spiritual enlightenment.
options.rationale: The cabal seized the items for their own tech, specifically to prevent public enlightenment.

options.label: D
options.text: They were donated to Nikola Tesla to fund his Wardenclyffe Tower project.
options.rationale: The operation was actually designed to prevent inventors like Tesla from utilizing such free energy technology.

questions.hint: Consider the two locations where these high-value objects were redistributed.

questions.question: What shifted in the atmospheric programs (sky spraying) after 2016?

options.label: A
options.text: The focus changed from chemical spraying to high-frequency sonic bombardment.
options.rationale: The primary change was in the composition of the sprayed materials rather than a move to purely sonic methods.

options.label: B
options.text: The programs were completely halted to allow the ozone layer to heal.
options.rationale: The programs didn't stop; they were flipped to use different materials with a positive resonance.

options.label: C
options.text: The spraying became more toxic to counter the rising frequency of the human population.
options.rationale: The programs were slowly flipped by higher councils, replacing toxic metals with beneficial elements.

options.label: D
options.text: The skies now utilize materials like monatomic gold and quartz to repair DNA.
options.rationale: Post-2016, higher councils and White Hat tech teams flipped the programs to monotomic gold, micro-structured quartz silica, colloidal silver, and structured water, repairing DNA and decalcifying the pineal gland.

questions.hint: Think about the transition from heavy metals to noble and crystalline elements.

questions.question: How does the simulation handle the concept of distance during long-distance travel?

options.label: A
options.text: By physically expanding the earth's surface to create more landmass.
options.rationale: The earth is a contained, layered dome; the concept of distance is a software illusion, not a physical expansion.

options.label: B
options.text: By allowing vessels to teleport instantly while masking the sensation from the passengers.
options.rationale: The system actually makes travel longer and more tedious to enforce the illusion of a round world with vast distances.

options.label: C
options.text: By utilizing high-speed subterranean trains that travel faster than light.
options.rationale: While tunnels exist, the perception of distance in air and sea travel is managed through frequency loops.

options.label: D
options.text: By guiding vessels through frequency corridors and pre-coded cloud loops.
options.rationale: Travelers are guided through frequency corridors or time loops; flights exceeding two hours are pre-coded loops of cloud backdrops while the destination simulation cell loads.

questions.hint: Recall the purpose of 'buffer time' and the two-hour flight corridors.

questions.question: What is the intended energetic effect of annual rituals like the Gunpowder Plot celebrations?

options.label: A
options.text: To purify the atmosphere using the high-frequency sparks of fireworks.
options.rationale: The ritual is a frequency-coding event for control, not an atmospheric purification method.

options.label: B
options.text: To celebrate the survival of historical figures and democratic values.
options.rationale: This is the narrative surface; the deeper effect is about frequency harvesting and obedience.

options.label: C
options.text: To harvest emotional excitement and fear to renew the spell of obedience.
options.rationale: Bonfires, fireworks, and burning effigies harvest collective emotional excitement and fear, renewing the spell of obedience and burning away the organic memory of dissent.

options.label: D
options.text: To signal star families that the local population is ready for contact.
options.rationale: These rituals are designed to keep consciousness trapped within the parasitic loop, far from true star family contact.

questions.hint: Focus on the use of mass emotional energy and the 'burning away' of dissent.

questions.question: What will happen to the perceived 'solidity' of modern architecture as the frequency of the soul increases?

options.label: A
options.text: The structures will turn into liquid gold due to the transmutation of matter.
options.rationale: The synthetic materials are hollow frames, not alchemical precursors to gold.

options.label: B
options.text: The overlays will flicker and dissolve, revealing hollow frequency frames.
options.rationale: When a soul frequency rises, solid overlays flicker and modern synthetic architecture appears as hollow frequency frames before dissolving into rubble.

options.label: C
options.text: The architecture will automatically realign to the new crystalline grid.
options.rationale: Modern synthetic materials are anti-resonant and will dissolve rather than aligning with organic crystalline structures.

options.label: D
options.text: The buildings will become even harder and more reinforced against the changes.
options.rationale: The solidity is an illusion that relies on a low-frequency match; it cannot survive a frequency rise.

questions.hint: Think about the concept of 'flickering' and the loss of projected solidity.

questions.question: Why are non-player characters (NPCs) expected to dissolve when the 3D overlay collapses?

options.label: A
options.text: Because they will be transported to a different simulation dome.
options.rationale: They fade like shadows rather than being relocated to another contained environment.

options.label: B
options.text: Because they will choose to leave the planet voluntarily through the sun gate.
options.rationale: NPCs lack the organic soul agency required to navigate the stargates independently.

options.label: C
options.text: Because they are biological beings who cannot survive high levels of radiation.
options.rationale: The issue is energetic and soul-based, not a matter of biological vulnerability to radiation.

options.label: D
options.text: Because they lack an energetic anchor or soul origin outside of the simulation.
options.rationale: NPCs are seeded through artificial solar bands and lack an energetic anchor outside of this simulation, so their vessels dissolve and fade like shadows when true light grids activate.

questions.hint: Consider the origin of these entities and their dependence on artificial frequency bands.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the Projection Dome Technology?

options.label: A
options.text: To project a false skin over the environment to hide organic realities.
options.rationale: Projection Dome Technology uses cloaking fields that bend light, sound, and frequency to project a false skin over the environment, hiding organic realities and stabilizing artificial densities.

options.label: B
options.text: To protect the population from dangerous solar flares and cosmic winds.
options.rationale: This narrative masks the true purpose of the domes, which is to contain and isolate consciousness.

options.label: C
options.text: To broadcast television and internet signals to every corner of the globe.
options.rationale: The broadcast systems are separate components; the domes focus on light and sound bending for environment cloaking.

options.label: D
options.text: To generate artificial weather patterns for agricultural control.
options.rationale: While weather is manipulated, the dome technology's primary purpose is perceptual cloaking and stabilization of density.

questions.hint: Recall the 'false skin' that hides the crystalline world.

questions.question: How are news broadcasts used to manage the behavior of human souls stained by NPC programming?

options.label: A
options.text: By using specific corner quotes and numbers as activation codes.
options.rationale: News broadcasts utilize specific corner quotes and numbers as activation codes that trigger NPCs to execute pre-programmed behavioral segments, often turning them against those who resist.

options.label: B
options.text: By subliminally broadcasting the coordinates of the Vatican Grid Anchor.
options.rationale: The coordinates are suppressed; the broadcasts focus on behavioral triggers rather than revealing infrastructure locations.

options.label: C
options.text: By providing accurate information that allows for logical decision-making.
options.rationale: The system uses manipulation and codes rather than factual or logical discourse.

options.label: D
options.text: By emitting high-frequency tones that encourage group meditation and peace.
options.rationale: The broadcasts aim for control, division, and triggering pre-programmed responses, not collective peace.

questions.hint: Look for the specific visual triggers mentioned near the edges of the screen.

questions.question: What happens to the loosh harvested during induced nightmares and mental breakdowns?

options.label: A
options.text: It is stored in the crystalline temple to be used for planetary healing.
options.rationale: Loosh is the energy of suffering and is used to maintain the parasitic control, not for healing.

options.label: B
options.text: It is converted into electricity to power the physical cities of the world.
options.rationale: While it powers systems, its primary use is to maintain the grid locks and the frequency overlays of the simulation.

options.label: C
options.text: It is used as a fuel source to power the grid locks of the artificial reality.
options.rationale: Emotional energy released during induced mental breakdowns and nightmares is harvested as loosh to power the grid locks.

options.label: D
options.text: It is used by the population to manifest their desired future timelines.
options.rationale: The energy is harvested from the population by the parasites, stripping them of their manifestive power.

questions.hint: Consider what fuels the technology that keeps the 'veils' and 'locks' in place.

questions.question: What is the true function of the sun in its original, non-hijacked state?

options.label: A
options.text: A reflecting mirror designed to bounce moonlight back to the earth.
options.rationale: The sun is a primary gateway, whereas the moon was originally a dream and integration station.

options.label: B
options.text: A massive furnace of burning hydrogen and helium gas.
options.rationale: This is the scientific deception; the sun's true nature is non-combustive and multidimensional.

options.label: C
options.text: A multidimensional stargate and transit gate for solar families.
options.rationale: The sun is not a burning ball of gas but a multidimensional stargate, a multi-banded crystalline gate for solar families later overlaid with an Amnesia Vortex.

options.label: D
options.text: A holographic projection source for the daytime sky simulation.
options.rationale: While the sun has been hijacked with artificial bands, it is an organic stargate at its core.

questions.hint: Think of it as a gateway or portal rather than a ball of gas.

questions.question: Which design elements in ancient architecture are used to pull cosmic current and amplify resonance?

options.label: A
options.text: Arches, copper domes, stone circles, and quartz inlay.
options.rationale: True ancient architecture uses arches, copper domes, quartz inlay, and stone circles aligned to ley-lines and star maps to pull cosmic current and amplify spiritual resonance.

options.label: B
options.text: High-pressure glass and plastic composites for transparency.
options.rationale: Synthetic materials like plastic are anti-resonant and do not pull cosmic current.

options.label: C
options.text: Sharp right angles, flat roofs, and reinforced steel beams.
options.rationale: These are characteristics of modern architectural suppression, not resonance amplification.

options.label: D
options.text: Underground bunkers lined with lead and radiation shielding.
options.rationale: Shielding blocks current; ancient architecture was designed to be open and conductive to stellar energy.

questions.hint: Focus on the shapes and natural materials that harmonize with the earth's grid.

questions.question: What is 'buffer time' as used in the simulation's geographic manipulation?

options.label: A
options.text: The period during which the Amnesia Vortex is deactivated for maintenance.
options.rationale: The vortex is a continuous mechanism; buffer time specifically relates to the loading of spatial cells during travel.

options.label: B
options.text: A delay coded into the illusion engine while a destination cell loads.
options.rationale: Buffer time is hard-coded into the illusion engine to hold awareness in a timed corridor while the destination simulation cell loads, enforcing the concept of distance, borders, and a massive round world.

options.label: C
options.text: The time required for the body to adjust to a new time zone.
options.rationale: Jet lag is a biological symptom, but buffer time is a hard-coded delay in the illusion engine itself.

options.label: D
options.text: A mandatory rest period for the pilots of long-distance flights.
options.rationale: Buffer time refers to the simulation loading process, not the biological needs of the crew.

questions.hint: It relates to the time spent in travel 'corridors' while the next location is being prepared.

questions.question: How do souls reclaim their original memories and intuitive sight during the current grid collapse?

options.label: A
options.text: By raising internal harmonic tones and ignoring NPC distractions.
options.rationale: By refusing fear, ignoring NPC distractions, and raising their internal harmonic tone, souls bypass decaying artificial grids as dormant DNA codes restore ancient memories and intuitive sight.

options.label: B
options.text: By undergoing specialized neurological surgery to bypass the V2K system.
options.rationale: The solution is spiritual and frequency-based, not a physical medical procedure within the simulation.

options.label: C
options.text: By studying the artificial historical texts provided in modern schools.
options.rationale: Those texts are part of the manufactured narrative and are designed to keep memories suppressed.

options.label: D
options.text: By waiting for the White Hat teams to release the stored Akashic data.
options.rationale: Reclamation is internal; souls must raise their own frequency rather than waiting for external data release.

questions.hint: The answer involves an internal shift in resonance and the reactivation of DNA.

questions.question: In the context of the solar hijack, what are the four to five artificial entry bands used for?

options.label: A
options.text: To protect the sun from the encroaching frequency collapse of the galaxy.
options.rationale: The collapse is of the artificial overlay; the bands are what is actually collapsing, not the sun itself.

options.label: B
options.text: To provide warmth to the various domes during the night cycle.
options.rationale: The bands are frequency filters for souls, not thermal regulators for the dome's atmosphere.

options.label: C
options.text: To route and log souls before they are sent through the Amnesia Vortex.
options.rationale: Four to five artificial entry bands around the sun route, log, and recycle souls: true human souls go into the amnesia stream, while artificial NPC shells are seeded through specialized bands.

options.label: D
options.text: To broadcast high-speed internet to the planets in the inner solar system.
options.rationale: The bands are for soul processing and routing, not for digital data communication.

questions.hint: Think about how the parasites manage the flow of traffic through the solar gate.

questions.question: What becomes possible for souls once the artificial frequency overlays completely collapse?

options.label: A
options.text: Travel will revert to immediate resonance alignment and teleportation.
options.rationale: Once the overlays collapse, travel instantly reverts to immediate resonance alignment, allowing souls to teleport through portals and reunite with their star families and original light worlds.

options.label: B
options.text: They will move to the moon to help rebuild the dream stations.
options.rationale: While the moon may be reclaimed, the immediate result is the ability to teleport and reunite with star families.

options.label: C
options.text: They will remain in the simulation to manage the dissolution of the NPC shells.
options.rationale: The focus is on homecoming and reclamation of original light worlds, not on managing the remains of the simulation.

options.label: D
options.text: They will finally be able to build permanent structures out of concrete.
options.rationale: Concrete is a dead, synthetic material; true souls will move toward resonant, organic creation instead.

questions.hint: Consider the shift from timed corridors to instant movement based on frequency.
